content:
Teo: quick sync
bout an edgecase with the profile shim. noticed fp8->int8 mapping flips top-1 on short factual prompts during canary.
Mina: how often? any obvious pattern?
Arjun: small prompts, numbers/dates mostly. looks like per-layer scale mismatch causes small shift.
Becca: we need a numeric "compatibility" check beyond bitwidth. propose a similarity score between quant fingerprints (e.g., cosine over per-tensor scales) with threshold.
Teo: +1. if similarity < 0.95 we refuse mapping unless owner approves.
Mina: also require a shadow preflight: enable mapping in shadow for N=100 prioritized samples and compute deg_delta before flipping.
Arjun: costy but safer. sampling should weight prompts flagged as "sensitivity=high" from eval repo.
Becca: runtime trace header proposal: X-precision-resolve: "orig=<orig_profile>;resolved=<resolved_profile>;kernel=<kernel_id>;fp_hash=<hash>" so we can join logs with eval results.
ops-bot: runbook snippet:
```
monitor: deg_score, hallucination_rate, p95_latency
pause mapping if deg_delta > 0.02 OR hallucination_rate + 5% absolute
action: set model-level mapping=disabled, notify owner, start shadow-replay
ramp: when re-enabling use traffic-split 1%->5%->25%->100% with warmup n=5
```
Mina: UI: show "shim-risk" on model page (low/med/high) computed from similarity + shadow delta; link to last shadow report.
Teo: also lint on onboarding: reject mappings for profiles that lack per-tensor scale metadata. require quant_fingerprint in upload.
Arjun: operational detail: allow temporary traffic-split and automatic rollback if deg_delta observed in live traffic.
Becca: add config example for ops teams:
```
precision_shim:
  default: passthrough
  tenants:
    acme: mapping
  mapping:
    "vendor/gptx/fp8-lite": "redwood/int8/gptx-safe-v1"
  safety:
    similarity_threshold: 0.95
    shadow_sample_size: 100
    live_ramp_steps: [1,5,25,100]
```
Teo: action items: Teo -> design sim metric draft, Arjun -> shadow preflight impl, Becca -> header logging + kernel tag, Mina -> UI flag + onboarding lint.
ops-bot: ticket created: QUANT-SHIM-2023 assigned to eng-ml.
Mina: let's keep mapping opt-in per model until we have solid telemetry. :thumbsup:
Teo: thanks all, will post a short doc and meet Friday for design review.
